02.0218 "Startup" means- 
(a) an entity in India recognised as a startup by the competent 
authority under Startup India initiative. 
(b) In case of a foreign entity, an entity fulfilling the criteria for 
turnover and period of incorporation/ registration as per Startup 
India Initiative and submitting declaration to that effect. 
Explanation: In calculating the turnover, reference rates of foreign 
currency of Reserve Bank of India shall prevail.
